title: Loading, error and retry states
prompt: Build a projects page that loads its data. When the page opens, show the text "Loading projects…" in a status region (role="status") for about one second, then show the list "Atlas", "Borealis" and "Cosmos". Above the list, a switch labelled "Fail loads" (off at first) and a "Reload" button. Reload shows the loading text again and loads the list again. While Fail loads is on, a load ends in an alert (role="alert") with the text "Could not load projects" and a "Try again" button, which loads again.
